bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge BigBang
bricks.description: Independent initial installer plus separately confirmed BigCrunch removal of every installed Forge package, including BigBang. Preview checks the local package graph and runs a Unity dry run; external dependents and unsafe local sources block removal. Verified removal cleans only exact Forge-owned settings and persists its result before self-unload. Game content, documentation, AI guides and third-party libraries remain. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 140 tests pass in each of wrapper-absent and wrapper-installed fixtures; real disposable self-removal retains Steamworks.NET and content sentinels. Interactive visual and keyboard checks were skipped at user request; full-God native group teardown and native Steam behavior remain unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge God
bricks.description: God remains the only mandatory shared brick. Build Forge uses BigBang-style borders and information boxes: Red action required or failure, Orange waiting/checking or working, and user-selected Yellow verified readiness. Written states, prerequisite explanations and scoped optional-owner assessments accompany each colour. Pending verification withdraws old ready ticks. The bounded Git metadata cache is retained. Unity 6000.6.3f1: full Editor suite 390 passed, zero failed, 11 conditional checks skipped. Native rendered normal/narrow, standalone/embedded and docked Build Forge views were reviewed; Back navigation remains pinned. Physical keyboard/mouse and alternate skin/high-DPI acceptance remain unverified. Consumers update manually.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Steam
bricks.description: Optional Windows x64 Mono preparation with passive inspection, reviewed defaults, shared findings, build checks and default-off local native activation. Requires God 0.37.0; other Forge peers remain optional. Exact Steamworks.NET 2025.164.1 profile is provisioned explicitly in the project. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 25 Editor and 4 injected Play Mode checks passed, zero failed or skipped. Actual standalone/embedded normal/narrow UI, Help, blocked Save and Undo reviewed. Current wrapper-present/absent Windows players run unconfigured without native loading; all six selected bricks run. Real native Steam integration, overlay, alternate skin/DPI and physical-device acceptance remain unverified. Customer distribution and Steam Deck remain deferred.
